title: Aperiodic Thickness-Optimized Dual-Band Stack
scientific_hypothesis: An aperiodic 24-layer HfO2/SiO2 stack with individually optimized thicknesses can achieve superior dual-band performance compared to periodic designs by decoupling the UV reflection and SWIR transmission requirements.
design_principle: Aperiodic multilayers break the strict wavelength scaling of periodic stacks, allowing independent control of spectral features. Needle optimization or gradient-based methods can find thickness distributions that maximize transmission in one band while maximizing reflection in another without the constraint of periodicity.
proposed_topology: Air | hfo2 | sio2 | hfo2 | sio2 | hfo2 | sio2 | hfo2 | sio2 | hfo2 | sio2 | hfo2 | sio2 | hfo2 | sio2 | hfo2 | sio2 | hfo2 | sio2 | hfo2 | sio2 | hfo2 | sio2 | hfo2 | sio2 | fused_silica substrate
soft_objectives: Minimize thickness variation between adjacent layers for manufacturability
manufacturing_considerations: Aperiodic thicknesses may require more precise deposition control
HfO2/SiO2 compatibility established per L05 and L08
expected_advantages: Greater design freedom than periodic stacks
Can suppress secondary reflection bands in SWIR
May achieve better spectral edge sharpness between UV and SWIR bands
known_risks: Higher optimization complexity with 24 independent variables
Aperiodic designs may be more sensitive to thickness errors
L01 notes UV filter challenges including solarization effects
execution_request_english: Design an aperiodic multilayer stack on fused_silica substrate with air incidence. Stack topology: 24 alternating layers starting with hfo2 adjacent to air, ending with SiO2 (Rodriguez-de_Marcos) adjacent to substrate (12 hfo2 layers, 12 SiO2 (Rodriguez-de_Marcos) layers). Initial thicknesses: all layers start at 100 nm as a neutral baseline. Optimization variables: all 24 individual layer thicknesses, each independently tunable from 30 nm to 200 nm. Evaluate performance at normal incidence, unpolarized light. Wavelength bands: 200-400 nm (maximize reflectance), 800-1500 nm (maximize transmittance). Material refractive indices from measured datasets for hfo2 and SiO2 (Rodriguez-de_Marcos). Total layer count fixed at 24.
